es: Reconocer frases que permiten a otra persona salvar la cara tras un error o un comentario brusco, y expresar lamentos propios con wish e if only.

vocabulary.es: salvar las apariencias, no quedar en ridículo

teaching.en: It's easily done; I once sent a private message to the whole team, so this is only an honest mistake.
teaching.es: Es fácil que pase; una vez envié un mensaje privado a todo el equipo, así que esto es solo un error sin mala intención.
teaching.explanationEs: It's easily done quita peso al error: lo presenta como algo que le pasa a cualquiera, incluido el hablante.
segments: It's easily done; I once sent a private message to
the whole team, so this is only an honest mistake.
teaching.audioText: It's easily done; I once sent a private message to the whole team, so this is only an honest mistake.

teaching.en: I may not have been clear about the deadline, so I am happy to take the blame for the confusion.
teaching.es: Puede que yo no haya sido claro con el plazo, así que acepto con gusto la culpa de la confusión.
teaching.explanationEs: I may not have been clear reparte la culpa; take the blame = asumirla de forma voluntaria.
segments: I may not have been clear about the deadline, so
I am happy to take the blame for the confusion.
teaching.audioText: I may not have been clear about the deadline, so I am happy to take the blame for the confusion.

teaching.en: No real harm was done, so I will let you off the hook and we can avoid an awkward conversation.
teaching.es: No hubo ningún daño real, así que te libero de la culpa y podemos evitar una conversación incómoda.
teaching.explanationEs: No real harm resta importancia a las consecuencias; off the hook = libre de responsabilidad.
segments: No real harm was done, so I will let you
off the hook and we can avoid an awkward conversation.
teaching.audioText: No real harm was done, so I will let you off the hook and we can avoid an awkward conversation.

teaching.en: I should warn you that the remark sounded sharp, but I'll give you the benefit of the doubt.
teaching.es: Debo avisarte de que el comentario sonó áspero, pero te daré el beneficio de la duda.
teaching.explanationEs: El beneficio de la duda supone buena intención; I should warn you suaviza el aviso antes de la crítica.
segments: I should warn you that the remark sounded sharp,
but I'll give you the benefit of the doubt.
teaching.audioText: I should warn you that the remark sounded sharp, but I'll give you the benefit of the doubt.

teaching.en: In hindsight, I wish I had made the change clear in person; I hope there are no hard feelings.
teaching.es: Visto ahora, ojalá hubiera dejado clara la modificación en persona; espero que no haya rencores.
teaching.explanationEs: Wish + had + participio lamenta algo pasado; in hindsight y no hard feelings suavizan el tono.
segments: In hindsight, I wish I had made the change clear
in person; I hope there are no hard feelings.
teaching.audioText: In hindsight, I wish I had made the change clear in person; I hope there are no hard feelings.

teaching.en: If only I had been clearer, the talk would not have been so awkward, and I could have helped you save face.
teaching.es: Si hubiera sido más claro, la charla no habría sido tan incómoda y te habría ayudado a salvar las apariencias.
teaching.explanationEs: If only + had + participio expresa un lamento sobre el pasado; save face = evitar que el otro quede mal.
segments: If only I had been clearer, the talk would not have
been so awkward, and I could have helped you save face.
teaching.audioText: If only I had been clearer, the talk would not have been so awkward, and I could have helped you save face.

prompt.es: Elige la frase de Sara que permite a Leo salvar la cara.

choices.text: You should have checked the attachment before you pressed send.
No harm done this time, but I will be checking everything you send from now on.
It's easily done; I nearly did the very same thing myself only last week.

feedback.es: Sara quita peso al error y se incluye a sí misma; las otras frases culpan a Leo con un reproche o con una amenaza disfrazada de consuelo.

hint.es: Busca la frase que normaliza el error sin acusar.

origin.text: Leo sent the client last year's price list by mistake and now sits red-faced at his desk. Sara, who saw the email go out, leans over and says something kind.

prompt.es: Completa: «No te preocupes: fue un error sin mala intención y no pasó nada grave.»

answer.text: mistake

feedback.es: An honest mistake presenta el fallo como involuntario; eso ayuda al otro a salvar la cara.

hint.es: Sustantivo: un fallo involuntario; empieza por m.

origin.text: Don't worry about the late report. It was an honest ___, and no real harm was done.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Puede que yo no haya sido claro con la hora.»

answer.text: I may not have been clear about the time

feedback.es: I may not have been clear reparte la culpa: el hablante asume parte del malentendido.

hint.es: Empieza por I may not have been y termina con about the time.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cómo ayuda la hablante a su compañera Mia.

choices.text: She hides the mistake from the manager in order to protect Mia.
She tells Mia off gently but promises to forgive her.
She insists that Mia explain herself to the manager.
She makes light of the mistake and shares responsibility for it.

feedback.es: La hablante quita peso («easily done») y reparte la culpa («I had not reminded her»); no esconde nada ni regaña.

origin.audio: Mia forgot to book the room, and the whole team arrived to find the door locked. I could have been angry, but I said it was easily done, that I had not reminded her, and that I would speak to the manager myself. She looked so relieved that we laughed about it over coffee.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase con el efecto que tiene sobre quien cometió el error.

pairs: It's easily done; it could happen to anyone
I may not have been clear about the start time
I'm sure you didn't mean it that way
No real harm done; we still have a week
I wish I had checked the room myself

feedback.es: Cada frase salva la cara de una manera: normaliza, reparte la culpa, supone buena intención, resta gravedad o lamenta algo propio.

pairs: It's easily done; it could happen to anyone
I may not have been clear about the start time
I'm sure you didn't mean it that way
No real harm done; we still have a week
I wish I had checked the room myself

prompt.es: ¿Qué efecto busca la autora con su respuesta a Tom?

choices.text: To reassure Tom and stop him feeling upset about the error.
To warn Tom that future errors will not be accepted.
To blame herself entirely and ask Tom to forgive her.
To point out that Tom should have checked the date twice.

feedback.es: Usa «easily done», comparte la culpa y resta importancia: tranquiliza a Tom, no le advierte, no se culpa por completo ni le reprocha.

origin.text: Dear Tom, thank you for telling me straight away that you sent the invitation with the wrong date. It is easily done, and I suspect my original note was not clear either. I have corrected it, so no real harm has been done, and please do not apologise again.

prompt.es: Escucha el relato y elige qué recurso usa Carlos para que Sara no pierda la cara.

choices.text: He takes the whole blame himself and apologises to the landlord.
He plays down the error and shares part of the responsibility.
He reminds her that the rent is late and must be paid today.
He warns her gently that the mistake could be very costly.

feedback.es: Carlos dice que es fácil que pase y que puede que él no fuera claro: quita peso y reparte la culpa, sin asumirla por entero ni advertir de costes.

origin.audio: Sara had promised to send the rent to the landlord by Friday, but on Monday she realised that she had used the wrong account number. She told Carlos, expecting him to be furious. Instead, he said it was easily done and added that he might not have been clear when he wrote the number on the fridge. He reminded her that the landlord had never charged a late fee, so no real harm was likely. Then he asked whether she wanted to ring the bank together. Sara said later that she felt lighter, although she still wished she had checked the number twice.

prompt.es: Escucha de nuevo: ¿qué sugiere el final del relato sobre cómo se siente Sara?

choices.text: Completely calm, since the matter is now closed.
Guilty, because Carlos ended up accepting most of the blame himself.
Relieved, although she still regrets her own mistake.
Worried, because the landlord may still refuse the payment.

feedback.es: Se siente más ligera, pero sigue deseando haber revisado el número: alivio con un resto de lamento propio.

origin.audio: Sara had promised to send the rent to the landlord by Friday, but on Monday she realised that she had used the wrong account number. She told Carlos, expecting him to be furious. Instead, he said it was easily done and added that he might not have been clear when he wrote the number on the fridge. He reminded her that the landlord had never charged a late fee, so no real harm was likely. Then he asked whether she wanted to ring the bank together. Sara said later that she felt lighter, although she still wished she had checked the number twice.

prompt.es: Completa: «Estoy dispuesta a darle el beneficio de la duda.»

answer.text: doubt

feedback.es: The benefit of the doubt es la fórmula fija para suponer buena intención sin tener pruebas.

origin.text: Leo's comment about the presentation sounded rude. He was tired, though, and he has never been unkind before, so I am willing to give him the benefit of the ___.

prompt.es: Ayuda a Tom a salvar la cara: resta importancia y asume parte de la culpa.

answer.text: It's easily done, Tom, and no real harm has been done; I may not have been clear about the invoice code.
accepted: It's easily done, Tom, and no real harm has been done; I may not have been clear about the invoice code.
It could happen to anyone, Tom. I might not have been clear about the code on the invoice, so let's fix it together.

feedback.es: La respuesta combina dos recursos: normaliza el error (It's easily done) y reparte la culpa (I may not have been clear).

origin.text: Tom envió al cliente la factura equivocada. Dile que es fácil que pase y que quizá tú tampoco fuiste claro con el código de la factura.

evidenceGroups: i may not have been clear
i might not have been clear
i may not have made it clear

prompt.es: ¿Qué valora más la autora en este mensaje a Mia?

choices.text: That Mia had already fixed the notes before anyone noticed the gap.
That the new checklist will prevent every future error.
That she was right to remind Mia on Friday.
That Mia was honest about her slip instead of hiding it.

feedback.es: La autora dice preferir a una colega que admite un fallo antes que a una que lo oculta: valora la honestidad, no el control ni su propio aviso.

origin.text: Hi Mia, thanks for telling me about the missing notes. I'm sure you didn't mean to leave them out, and honestly, I should have reminded you on Friday. In hindsight, the plan was vague, so let's agree on a checklist and move on. No hard feelings at all; I would rather have a colleague who admits a slip than one who hides it.

prompt.es: Ordena: «No pasó nada grave y podemos seguir adelante.»

answer.text: No real harm was done and we can move on

feedback.es: No real harm was done resta importancia y and we can move on cierra el asunto sin reproches.

prompt.es: Completa: «Es amable dejarlo libre de culpa y seguir adelante.»

answer.text: let

feedback.es: Let someone off the hook es la expresión para librar a alguien de la culpa; take o get him off the hook también existen.

origin.text: Everyone makes mistakes at work. When a colleague slips, it is kind to ___ him off the hook and simply move on.

es: Responder a peticiones difíciles sin comprometerse ni cerrar la puerta, con fórmulas corteses como bear in mind y get back to you.

teaching.en: Thank you; I will bear in mind what you said, but I cannot promise anything at this stage.
teaching.es: Gracias; tendré en cuenta lo que dijiste, pero no puedo prometer nada por ahora.
teaching.explanationEs: Bear in mind = tener en cuenta; con can't promise el resto va en positivo: anything, no nothing.
segments: Thank you; I will bear in mind what you
said, but I cannot promise anything at this stage.
teaching.audioText: Thank you; I will bear in mind what you said, but I cannot promise anything at this stage.

teaching.en: That is worth considering, so let me get back to you next week once I have checked the budget.
teaching.es: Eso merece ser considerado, así que déjame responderte la semana próxima cuando haya revisado el presupuesto.
teaching.explanationEs: Worth considering reconoce la idea sin aceptarla; let me get back to you fija un plazo para responder.
segments: That is worth considering, so let me get back to
you next week once I have checked the budget.
teaching.audioText: That is worth considering, so let me get back to you next week once I have checked the budget.

teaching.en: I would rather not commit to a date yet; I want to keep my options open until the schedule is clearer.
teaching.es: Prefiero no comprometerme con una fecha todavía; quiero dejar mis opciones abiertas hasta que el horario esté más claro.
teaching.explanationEs: Commit to + sustantivo (a date); keep my options open explica por qué no decides aún.
segments: I would rather not commit to a date yet; I want
to keep my options open until the schedule is clearer.
teaching.audioText: I would rather not commit to a date yet; I want to keep my options open until the schedule is clearer.

teaching.en: It depends on the weather and the team, so I would prefer to hold off on a final decision until Friday.
teaching.es: Depende del clima y del equipo, así que preferiría aplazar la decisión final hasta el viernes.
teaching.explanationEs: Depends se une a on (nunca of); hold off on = aplazar, dejar algo para más adelante.
segments: It depends on the weather and the team, so I would
prefer to hold off on a final decision until Friday.
teaching.audioText: It depends on the weather and the team, so I would prefer to hold off on a final decision until Friday.

teaching.en: Thanks for the suggestion; a polite holding reply like this can buy some time without closing the door.
teaching.es: Gracias por la sugerencia; una respuesta cortés como esta puede ganar tiempo sin cerrar la puerta.
teaching.explanationEs: Buy some time = ganar tiempo; la respuesta no compromete, pero tampoco ofende.
segments: Thanks for the suggestion; a polite holding reply like
this can buy some time without closing the door.
teaching.audioText: Thanks for the suggestion; a polite holding reply like this can buy some time without closing the door.

teaching.en: I can't promise anything, which leaves the door open, whereas saying that it is impossible would close it.
teaching.es: No puedo prometer nada, lo cual deja la puerta abierta, mientras que decir que es imposible la cerraría.
teaching.explanationEs: Una respuesta no comprometida evita tanto el sí como el no rotundo: deja abierta la posibilidad.
segments: I can't promise anything, which leaves the door open,
whereas saying that it is impossible would close it.
teaching.audioText: I can't promise anything, which leaves the door open, whereas saying that it is impossible would close it.

prompt.es: Elige la respuesta no comprometida pero cortés de Carlos.

choices.text: I'll bear that in mind, but I'll have to check the diary first of all.
No, I'm afraid that the minibus is never available at weekends at all.
Of course, it's yours whenever you like, there's no problem at all.

feedback.es: Carlos no dice sí ni no: toma nota de la petición y fija un paso previo; las otras respuestas o cierran la puerta o prometen demasiado.

hint.es: Busca la respuesta que ni acepta ni rechaza y deja una acción pendiente.

origin.text: Tom has just asked Carlos to lend him the club's minibus for a weekend trip. Carlos has not checked the booking diary yet and does not want to refuse or promise anything.

prompt.es: Completa: «Depende del presupuesto; te respondo el viernes.»

answer.text: depends

feedback.es: Depends se construye con on y marca que la respuesta queda condicionada.

hint.es: Verbo en tercera persona; va seguido de on.

origin.text: Mia asked whether the club could pay for the trip. It ___ on the budget, and I said that I would get back to her on Friday.

prompt.es: Ordena: «No puedo prometer nada en esta etapa.»

answer.text: I cannot promise anything at this stage
accepted: I cannot promise anything at this stage
At this stage I cannot promise anything

feedback.es: Con cannot promise el resto va en positivo (anything) y at this stage sitúa la respuesta en el tiempo.

hint.es: Empieza por I cannot y usa anything, no nothing.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hace la hablante con la petición de su vecino.

choices.text: She neither accepts nor refuses, and names a day for her answer.
She postpones her answer because she wants to prepare the speech first.
She accepts in principle but asks him to confirm the date on Tuesday.
She refuses politely, blaming her busy week at work.

feedback.es: La hablante ni acepta ni rechaza: «bear it in mind», «depended on my week» y una fecha para responder; el trabajo es la condición, no el motivo de un rechazo.

origin.audio: When my neighbour asked me to speak at the street party, I did not want to say no, but I could not say yes either. So I told him I would bear it in mind, that it depended on my week at work, and that I would get back to him on Tuesday. He seemed perfectly happy.

prompt.es: ¿Qué respuesta deja la puerta abierta sin prometer nada?

choices.text: Yes, of course, I will be there at nine sharp, so don't worry at all.
Possibly; I can't promise anything, but let me check and call you this evening.
I'm afraid that's impossible, and I never work on Saturdays anyway.
Maybe I'll come, maybe I won't; it isn't really my problem, is it?

feedback.es: Es cortés, no promete y fija un momento para responder; las demás aceptan del todo, cierran del todo o suenan descorteses.

origin.text: A colleague asks Sara to cover her Saturday shift and needs an answer today. Sara has a family lunch that might run late, so she cannot be sure of anything.

prompt.es: Completa: «No quiero comprometerme con una fecha todavía.»

answer.text: commit

feedback.es: Commit to + fecha significa comprometerse con ella; agree to también sería posible, pero commit es la fórmula de este tema.

origin.text: I'd love to help with the fundraiser, but I do not want to ___ to a date yet. I'll keep my options open until the rota is confirmed.

prompt.es: Según el correo de Mia, ¿qué le pide a Leo?

choices.text: A lighter role on the committee than the one he offered.
A copy of the minutes, since she cannot attend the next meeting.
More time, so that she can decide without letting the group down.
Permission to join the committee for one meeting only.

feedback.es: Mia pide plazo hasta final de mes para decidir sin fallar al grupo; la lectura de las actas es lo que hará mientras tanto.

origin.text: Hi Leo, thanks for inviting me to join the planning committee. I'm flattered, and it is certainly worth considering. That said, I'm not sure my workload will allow it this term, and I would hate to say yes and then let the group down. Could you give me until the end of the month? In the meantime I'll keep my options open and read the minutes, so that I can contribute properly if I do join. I can't promise anything, but I'll get back to you before the next meeting. Best wishes, Mia

prompt.es: ¿Qué sugiere el correo de Mia sobre sus probabilidades de aceptar?

choices.text: That she has already decided to refuse and is only being polite.
That she will accept as soon as her workload becomes lighter.
That she needs Leo to persuade her with a better offer.
That she is seriously considering it but will not commit until certain.

feedback.es: Llama a la idea «worth considering», lee las actas y mantiene sus opciones abiertas: valora aceptar, pero no se compromete hasta estar segura.

origin.text: Hi Leo, thanks for inviting me to join the planning committee. I'm flattered, and it is certainly worth considering. That said, I'm not sure my workload will allow it this term, and I would hate to say yes and then let the group down. Could you give me until the end of the month? In the meantime I'll keep my options open and read the minutes, so that I can contribute properly if I do join. I can't promise anything, but I'll get back to you before the next meeting. Best wishes, Mia

prompt.es: Completa: «Deberíamos aplazar la decisión final hasta que se apruebe el presupuesto.»

answer.text: hold

feedback.es: Hold off on significa aplazar una decisión; se mantiene la puerta abierta hasta tener datos.

origin.text: We should ___ off on the final decision until the budget is approved. Nobody wants to commit to a date that may have to change.

prompt.es: Responde sin comprometerte a la petición de una vecina.

answer.text: Thanks for asking. I'll bear that in mind, but I can't promise anything at this stage. Let me get back to you on Monday.
accepted: Thanks for asking. I'll bear that in mind, but I can't promise anything at this stage. Let me get back to you on Monday.
Thank you for thinking of me. I will bear it in mind, but it depends on my plans, so I can't promise anything yet. I'll get back to you on Monday.
That's kind of you. I'll keep that in mind, but I cannot guarantee anything just yet. I'll let you know on Monday.

feedback.es: La respuesta combina reconocimiento, advertencia de que no hay garantía y un plazo para contestar.

origin.text: Una vecina te pide que cuides su perro el fin de semana largo y aún no sabes si viajarás. Di que lo tendrás en cuenta, que no puedes prometer nada todavía y que le contestarás el lunes.

prompt.es: ¿Qué da a entender realmente el remitente en esta respuesta?

choices.text: That a change of date is possible but has not been agreed.
That the suggestion has been rejected, but in a very polite manner overall.
That the workshop will move to July once the board meets.
That the board has already refused to fund the workshop.

feedback.es: Reconoce la idea, pero sin presupuesto aprobado no promete fecha y pospone la respuesta: algo posible pero aún no acordado.

origin.text: Dear Sara, thanks for the suggestion about moving the workshop to July. It is an interesting idea and I will certainly bear it in mind. At this stage, though, the budget has not been approved, and I would not want to promise a date that I cannot guarantee. Let me get back to you after the board meets next Tuesday.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Depende del presupuesto; déjame responderte.»

answer.text: It depends on the budget so let me get back to you

feedback.es: Depends on introduce la condición y let me get back to you deja la respuesta para más tarde.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué responde la hablante a la petición del auto.

choices.text: She has promised the car, pending a word with her brother.
It is uncertain, and she will reply to her friend by Friday night.
She cannot lend it because her brother needs it himself for the weekend.
She advises her friend to ask her brother directly, as he holds the keys.

feedback.es: La hablante no promete nada, depende de su hermano y fija un plazo para contestar: respuesta no comprometida.

origin.audio: She asked whether I could lend her the car for the weekend. I said it depended on my brother, who has the keys, and that I couldn't promise anything. I told her I would get back to her before Friday evening.

es: Leer un comunicado entre dos asociaciones y traducir sus frases diplomáticas a lenguaje directo, repasando las preguntas reportadas.

vocabulary.es: un intercambio franco, una discusión dura
quedarse a las puertas de, no llegar a

teaching.en: When a statement says that the association will take note of your complaint, it may simply mean that it has heard you.
teaching.es: Cuando un comunicado dice que la asociación tomará nota de tu queja, puede significar simplemente que te ha escuchado.
teaching.explanationEs: Take note of = tomar nota: reconoce que recibió el mensaje, pero no promete actuar.
segments: When a statement says that the association will take note of
your complaint, it may simply mean that it has heard you.
teaching.audioText: When a statement says that the association will take note of your complaint, it may simply mean that it has heard you.

teaching.en: In a statement, a frank exchange of views is code for a disagreement that was heated, even if nobody shouted.
teaching.es: En un comunicado, un intercambio franco de opiniones es una forma cifrada de decir que hubo un desacuerdo acalorado, aunque nadie gritara.
teaching.explanationEs: Frank suena amable, pero suele esconder una discusión dura; code for = forma cifrada de decir.
segments: In a statement, a frank exchange of views is code
for a disagreement that was heated, even if nobody shouted.
teaching.audioText: In a statement, a frank exchange of views is code for a disagreement that was heated, even if nobody shouted.

teaching.en: We note with concern that the garden has still not been cleaned, which reads as a polite complaint.
teaching.es: Observamos con preocupación que el jardín sigue sin limpiarse, lo que se lee como una queja cortés.
teaching.explanationEs: We note with concern = estamos preocupados y queremos que cambie; la queja va envuelta en una fórmula neutra.
segments: We note with concern that the garden has still
not been cleaned, which reads as a polite complaint.
teaching.audioText: We note with concern that the garden has still not been cleaned, which reads as a polite complaint.

teaching.en: We regret that the meeting ended early, yet what is on the record is sorrow, not an admission of fault.
teaching.es: Lamentamos que la reunión terminara pronto, pero lo que consta oficialmente es pena, no una admisión de culpa.
teaching.explanationEs: Regret expresa pesar sin reconocer responsabilidad; on the record = lo que queda dicho oficialmente.
segments: We regret that the meeting ended early, yet what is
on the record is sorrow, not an admission of fault.
teaching.audioText: We regret that the meeting ended early, yet what is on the record is sorrow, not an admission of fault.

teaching.en: The association may remain committed to talks and still stop short of any concession, so read between the lines.
teaching.es: La asociación puede seguir comprometida con el diálogo y aun así no llegar a ninguna concesión, así que lee entre líneas.
teaching.explanationEs: Remain committed = seguir en la mesa; stop short of = no llegar a; read between the lines = leer lo no dicho.
segments: The association may remain committed to talks and still stop
short of any concession, so read between the lines.
teaching.audioText: The association may remain committed to talks and still stop short of any concession, so read between the lines.

teaching.en: The committee asked whether the association would reconsider its decision, which is a polite way of saying that it should.
teaching.es: El comité preguntó si la asociación reconsideraría su decisión, que es una forma cortés de decir que debería hacerlo.
teaching.explanationEs: En una pregunta reportada el orden es afirmativo (whether + sujeto + verbo); aquí la pregunta funciona como petición.
segments: The committee asked whether the association would reconsider its decision,
which is a polite way of saying that it should.
teaching.audioText: The committee asked whether the association would reconsider its decision, which is a polite way of saying that it should.

prompt.es: ¿Qué significa realmente «a frank exchange of views» en este comunicado?

choices.text: The two sides agreed on most points and spoke informally.
The two sides disagreed strongly and said so openly to each other.
The two sides avoided the subject and talked about other matters.

feedback.es: En lenguaje diplomático, franco suele esconder un desacuerdo abierto: hubo discusión, no acuerdo ni evasión.

hint.es: Frank suena amable, pero en un comunicado suele ser código de discusión dura.

origin.text: The Garden Association and the Youth Club issued a shared statement after Tuesday's meeting. It said that the two sides had held a frank exchange of views and that both remained committed to a solution.

prompt.es: Completa: «Observamos con preocupación que el jardín sigue sin limpiarse.»

answer.text: concern

feedback.es: We note with concern traduce una queja como preocupación oficial; regret o dismay serían variantes posibles.

hint.es: Sustantivo que significa «preocupación»; empieza por c.

origin.text: The letter said: «We note with ___ that the garden has still not been cleaned.» In plain terms, the writers are worried and want a change.

origin.audio: The two associations published a shared statement on Friday after weeks of tension over the shared garden. It begins by noting with concern that the paths have not been cleaned. Sceptical throughout, accepting only a rota that is never reviewed.
Bored, agreeing simply to end the meeting sooner.

feedback.es: Leo duda de que alguien cumpla un calendario y no quiere prometer nada, pero acepta probarlo dos semanas con revisión; nadie le presiona y su condición es precisamente la revisión.

origin.audio: Sara called the flat meeting for eight o'clock. She began by saying that she would mediate, not judge, and that first on the agenda were the chores. Carlos raised the kitchen: lately, he said, he had washed other people's plates three times, and he wished someone would notice. Ana replied that she had not realised, and asked whether a rota might help. Leo was not convinced. He said rotas sound fine on paper, but nobody follows them, and he did not want to promise anything. Sara let him finish, then asked if he would try it for two weeks. He agreed, although only after she promised that they would review it at the end of the month.

prompt.es: Escucha de nuevo: ¿qué sugiere el relato sobre el estilo de Sara como mediadora?

choices.text: That she pushes the group to a decision quickly, before doubts can be raised.
That she quietly prefers Carlos's view but hides it to seem neutral.
That she lets people finish and secures a small, short-term promise.
That she gives up on the rota the moment Leo objects.

feedback.es: Sara deja terminar a Leo, propone una prueba corta y promete revisarla: consigue un compromiso pequeño y revisable sin imponer ni tomar partido.

origin.text: Carlos and Ana see the chores very differently. Before the rota starts, they will have to ___ out their differences, preferably over a cup of tea.

prompt.es: Como mediador, escribe lo que dirías en la reunión, de la apertura al acuerdo.

answer.text: Thanks, everyone, for coming. Let me mediate, and I hope we can settle this calmly. First on the agenda: the chores. Lately, the kitchen has been a mess, and I wish we could keep it tidy together. I am sure nobody wants a problem, and I do not want to blame anyone. I was wondering if everyone could wash their dishes on the same day. Could I ask whether a rota would suit you from Monday? Mia asked me whether we could start a cleaning rota, and I think it is a fair idea. Much as we are all busy, what matters is that each person does a fair share. I would like to hear everyone out before we decide. So, shall we agree that we start the rota on Monday, and that we meet again in two weeks to iron out any problems? Are we all happy with that?

Good evening, everybody. Let me mediate this meeting, and let us try to settle the chores today. The kitchen has been a mess lately, and I wish we could share the work. I was wondering if each of us could clean one day a week. Could I ask whether Monday would suit everybody? Mia asked whether we could start a cleaning rota, and I think it is a good idea. I understand that some of you are busy, but what matters is that the work is fair, and I would like to hear everyone out first. Shall we propose a rota from Monday, and meet again in two weeks to see how it goes? Are we all happy to agree on that?

feedback.es: Una buena mediación abre con orden, expone la queja con wish, pregunta con tacto, reporta lo que preguntó Mia y cierra con un acuerdo.

origin.text: Reunión en tu departamento compartido. Como mediador, escribe unas 210–270 palabras: abre la reunión; expón una queja suave con wish (la cocina desordenada); haz dos preguntas indirectas (I was wondering if…; Could I ask whether…?); reporta lo que preguntó Mia (asked whether…); y propón un acuerdo: turnos de limpieza desde el lunes.

prompt.es: ¿Qué dan a entender estas actas sobre el resultado de la revisión del calendario?

choices.text: That the rota has failed, since one flatmate cannot keep to it.
That Leo has used a clash of classes as an excuse to avoid the rota.
That the mediator is pressing everyone to keep the original days.
That the rota mostly works and needs only a small adjustment.

feedback.es: La mayoría lo ve viable y solo choca un día con las clases de Leo: basta un ajuste pequeño, y el mediador propone cambiar a martes.

origin.text: Minutes of the flat meeting: the group reviewed the chores rota after two weeks. Most of the flatmates felt that it was workable, although Leo pointed out that Thursday clashes with his classes. Ana asked whether the days could be swapped. The mediator suggested trying Tuesday instead and added that nobody should feel forced to accept a change that they cannot keep.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Ojalá pudiéramos mantener la discusión encaminada.»

answer.text: I wish we could keep the discussion on track

feedback.es: Wish + could expresa un deseo sin presionar; keep the discussion on track es la colocación del mediador.

prompt.es: Completa: «Preguntó si el grupo podía hallar una solución viable.»

answer.text: find

feedback.es: Find a workable solution es la colocación habitual; reach o come up with también encajan.

origin.text: The mediator asked whether the group could ___ a workable solution by the end of the evening, before everybody went home.
